---
title: "Timeline"
subtitle: "Year-by-year milestones, September 2026 through August 2031"
---

The project runs two full breeding-to-field cycles over five years. Milestones below are as committed in the approved project plan. This page is updated as milestones are met.

## Year 1 · 2026–2027

- Governance established; trainees recruited
- Stakeholder Advisory Board formalized; commercial MOUs signed
- Broodstock conditioning and priming begin at all three coastal sites
- Baseline metabolic phenotyping complete
- Shared data schemas and GitHub organization established; PRISM Portal wireframes

## Year 2 · 2027–2028

- Cycle 1 spawning: pedigreed families from primed and control parents
- Field deployments begin at contrasting sites on all three coasts
- First regional workshops
- Prototype dashboard delivered; Stakeholder Advisory Board review
- Trainee rotations start; formative evaluation

## Year 3 · 2028–2029

- 12-month Cycle 1 field performance data complete
- Cycle 2 launched with refined protocols
- Machine-learning predictive models trained
- Beta dashboard and PRISM Portal released
- Sustainability planning begins

## Year 4 · 2029–2030

- Models and priming protocols validated on independent Cycle 2 data
- Dashboard and PRISM Portal publicly released
- ADAPT micro-credential piloted
- At least 3 hatcheries priming commercially
- Second formative evaluation

## Year 5 · 2030–2031

- National capstone workshop
- Final publications, target of at least 8
- Implementation manuals and cost–benefit analyses delivered
- Open data and code repositories released
- Summative external evaluation and final report

## Standing commitments

Quarterly all-investigator teleconferences, semi-annual Stakeholder Advisory Board meetings, an annual in-person meeting at a rotating partner site, and annual NIFA progress reports.
